<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Project Overview</h2><a id="user-content-project-overview" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Project Overview" href="https://github.com/najirh/Retail-Sales-Analysis-SQL-Project--P1/blob/main/README.md#project-overview"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Project Title</strong>: Retail Sales Analysis<br>
<strong>Level</strong>: Beginner<br>
<strong>Database</strong>: <code>p1_retail_db</code></p>
<p dir="auto">This project is designed to demonstrate SQL skills and techniques typically used by data analysts to explore, clean, and analyze retail sales data. The project involves setting up a retail sales database, performing exploratory data analysis (EDA), and answering specific business questions through SQL queries. This project is ideal for those who are starting their journey in data analysis and want to build a solid foundation in SQL.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Objectives</h2><a id="user-content-objectives" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Objectives" href="https://github.com/najirh/Retail-Sales-Analysis-SQL-Project--P1/blob/main/README.md#objectives"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Set up a retail sales database</strong>: Create and populate a retail sales database with the provided sales data.</li>
<li><strong>Data Cleaning</strong>: Identify and remove any records with missing or null values.</li>
<li><strong>Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)</strong>: Perform basic exploratory data analysis to understand the dataset.</li>
<li><strong>Business Analysis</strong>: Use SQL to answer specific business questions and derive insights from the sales data.</li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Project Structure</h2><a id="user-content-project-structure" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Project Structure" href="https://github.com/najirh/Retail-Sales-Analysis-SQL-Project--P1/blob/main/README.md#project-structure"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">1. Database Setup</h3><a id="user-content-1-database-setup" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 1. Database Setup" href="https://github.com/najirh/Retail-Sales-Analysis-SQL-Project--P1/blob/main/README.md#1-database-setup"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Database Creation</strong>: The project starts by creating a database named <code>p1_retail_db</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Table Creation</strong>: A table named <code>retail_sales</code> is created to store the sales data. The table structure includes columns for transaction ID, sale date, sale time, customer ID, gender, age, product category, quantity sold, price per unit, cost of goods sold (COGS), and total sale amount.</li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">CREATE</span> <span class="pl-k">DATABASE</span> <span class="pl-en">p1_retail_db</span>;

<span class="pl-k">CREATE</span> <span class="pl-k">TABLE</span> <span class="pl-en">retail_sales</span>
(
    transactions_id <span class="pl-k">INT</span> <span class="pl-k">PRIMARY KEY</span>,
    sale_date <span class="pl-k">DATE</span>,	
    sale_time <span class="pl-k">TIME</span>,
    customer_id <span class="pl-k">INT</span>,	
    gender <span class="pl-k">VARCHAR</span>(<span class="pl-c1">10</span>),
    age <span class="pl-k">INT</span>,
    category <span class="pl-k">VARCHAR</span>(<span class="pl-c1">35</span>),
    quantity <span class="pl-k">INT</span>,
    price_per_unit FLOAT,	
    cogs FLOAT,
    total_sale FLOAT
);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="CREATE DATABASE p1_retail_db;

CREATE TABLE retail_sales
(
    transactions_id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    sale_date DATE,	
    sale_time TIME,
    customer_id INT,	
    gender VARCHAR(10),
    age INT,
    category VARCHAR(35),
    quantity INT,
    price_per_unit FLOAT,	
    cogs FLOAT,
    total_sale FLOAT
);" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">2. Data Exploration &amp; Cleaning</h3><a id="user-content-2-data-exploration--cleaning" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 2. Data Exploration &amp; Cleaning" href="https://github.com/najirh/Retail-Sales-Analysis-SQL-Project--P1/blob/main/README.md#2-data-exploration--cleaning"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Record Count</strong>: Determine the total number of records in the dataset.</li>
<li><strong>Customer Count</strong>: Find out how many unique customers are in the dataset.</li>
<li><strong>Category Count</strong>: Identify all unique product categories in the dataset.</li>
<li><strong>Null Value Check</strong>: Check for any null values in the dataset and delete records with missing data.</li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> <span class="pl-c1">COUNT</span>(<span class="pl-k">*</span>) <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales;
<span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> <span class="pl-c1">COUNT</span>(DISTINCT customer_id) <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales;
<span class="pl-k">SELECT DISTINCT</span> category <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales;

<span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> <span class="pl-k">*</span> <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">WHERE</span> 
    sale_date IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> sale_time IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> customer_id IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> 
    gender IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> age IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> category IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> 
    quantity IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> price_per_unit IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> cogs IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span>;

<span class="pl-k">DELETE</span> <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">WHERE</span> 
    sale_date IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> sale_time IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> customer_id IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> 
    gender IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> age IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> category IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> 
    quantity IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> price_per_unit IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span> <span class="pl-k">OR</span> cogs IS <span class="pl-k">NULL</span>;</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail_sales;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM retail_sales;
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM retail_sales;

SELECT * FROM retail_sales
WHERE 
    sale_date IS NULL OR sale_time IS NULL OR customer_id IS NULL OR 
    gender IS NULL OR age IS NULL OR category IS NULL OR 
    quantity IS NULL OR price_per_unit IS NULL OR cogs IS NULL;

DELETE FROM retail_sales
WHERE 
    sale_date IS NULL OR sale_time IS NULL OR customer_id IS NULL OR 
    gender IS NULL OR age IS NULL OR category IS NULL OR 
    quantity IS NULL OR price_per_unit IS NULL OR cogs IS NULL;" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">The following SQL queries were developed to answer specific business questions:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Write a SQL query to retrieve all columns for sales made on '2022-11-05</strong>:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> <span class="pl-k">*</span>
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">WHERE</span> sale_date <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>2022-11-05<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>;</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<ol start="2" dir="auto">
<li><strong>Write a SQL query to retrieve all transactions where the category is 'Clothing' and the quantity sold is more than 4 in the month of Nov-2022</strong>:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> 
  <span class="pl-k">*</span>
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">WHERE</span> 
    category <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>Clothing<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>
    <span class="pl-k">AND</span> 
    TO_CHAR(sale_date, <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>YYYY-MM<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>) <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>2022-11<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>
    <span class="pl-k">AND</span>
    quantity <span class="pl-k">&gt;=</span> <span class="pl-c1">4</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="SELECT 
  *
FROM retail_sales
WHERE 
    category = 'Clothing'
    AND 
    TO_CHAR(sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '2022-11'
    AND
    quantity &gt;= 4" tabindex="0" role="button">

<ol start="3" dir="auto">
<li><strong>Write a SQL query to calculate the total sales (total_sale) for each category.</strong>:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> 
    category,
    <span class="pl-c1">SUM</span>(total_sale) <span class="pl-k">as</span> net_sale,
    <span class="pl-c1">COUNT</span>(<span class="pl-k">*</span>) <span class="pl-k">as</span> total_orders
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">GROUP BY</span> <span class="pl-c1">1</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="SELECT 
    category,
    SUM(total_sale) as net_sale,
    COUNT(*) as total_orders
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY 1" tabindex="0" role="button">

<ol start="4" dir="auto">
<li><strong>Write a SQL query to find the average age of customers who purchased items from the 'Beauty' category.</strong>:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span>
    ROUND(<span class="pl-c1">AVG</span>(age), <span class="pl-c1">2</span>) <span class="pl-k">as</span> avg_age
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">WHERE</span> category <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>Beauty<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(age), 2) as avg_age
FROM retail_sales
WHERE category = 'Beauty'" tabindex="0" role="button">

<ol start="7" dir="auto">
<li><strong>Write a SQL query to calculate the average sale for each month. Find out best selling month in each year</strong>:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> 
       year,
       month,
    avg_sale
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> 
(    
<span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> 
    EXTRACT(YEAR <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> sale_date) <span class="pl-k">as</span> year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> sale_date) <span class="pl-k">as</span> month,
    <span class="pl-c1">AVG</span>(total_sale) <span class="pl-k">as</span> avg_sale,
    RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> sale_date) <span class="pl-k">ORDER BY</span> <span class="pl-c1">AVG</span>(total_sale) <span class="pl-k">DESC</span>) <span class="pl-k">as</span> rank
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">GROUP BY</span> <span class="pl-c1">1</span>, <span class="pl-c1">2</span>
) <span class="pl-k">as</span> t1
<span class="pl-k">WHERE</span> rank <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">1</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="SELECT 
       year,
       month,
    avg_sale
FROM 
(    
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) as year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) as month,
    AVG(total_sale) as avg_sale,
    RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) ORDER BY AVG(total_sale) DESC) as rank
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY 1, 2
) as t1
WHERE rank = 1" tabindex="0" role="button">

<ol start="8" dir="auto">
<li>**Write a SQL query to find the top 5 customers based on the highest total sales **:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> 
    customer_id,
    <span class="pl-c1">SUM</span>(total_sale) <span class="pl-k">as</span> total_sales
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
<span class="pl-k">GROUP BY</span> <span class="pl-c1">1</span>
<span class="pl-k">ORDER BY</span> <span class="pl-c1">2</span> <span class="pl-k">DESC</span>
<span class="pl-k">LIMIT</span> <span class="pl-c1">5</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

    customer_id,
    SUM(total_sale) as total_sales
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5" tabindex="0" role="button">

<ol start="10" dir="auto">
<li><strong>Write a SQL query to create each shift and number of orders (Example Morning &lt;12, Afternoon Between 12 &amp; 17, Evening &gt;17)</strong>:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre>WITH hourly_sale
<span class="pl-k">AS</span>
(
<span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> <span class="pl-k">*</span>,
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> sale_time) <span class="pl-k">&lt;</span> <span class="pl-c1">12</span> THEN <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>Morning<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR <span class="pl-k">FROM</span> sale_time) BETWEEN <span class="pl-c1">12</span> <span class="pl-k">AND</span> <span class="pl-c1">17</span> THEN <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>Afternoon<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>
        ELSE <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>Evening<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span>
    END <span class="pl-k">as</span> shift
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> retail_sales
)
<span class="pl-k">SELECT</span> 
    shift,
    <span class="pl-c1">COUNT</span>(<span class="pl-k">*</span>) <span class="pl-k">as</span> total_orders    
<span class="pl-k">FROM</span> hourly_sale
<span class="pl-k">GROUP BY</span> shift</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="WITH hourly_sale
AS
(
SELECT *,
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM sale_time) &lt; 12 THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM sale_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon'
        ELSE 'Evening'
    END as shift
FROM retail_sales
)
SELECT 
    shift,
    COUNT(*) as total_orders    
FROM hourly_sale
GROUP BY shift" tabindex="0" role="button">
